search_text: published ZDI-22-1615 ZDI-CAN-17332 TP-Link TL-WR940N httpd Incorrect Implementation of Authentication Algorithm Information Disclosure Vulnerability 2022-11-21 CVE-2022-43635 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2022-43635 6.5 AV:A/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:N ['TP-Link'] ['TL-WR940N'] This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of TP-Link TL-WR940N routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the httpd service, which listens on TCP port 80 by default. The issue results from the incorrect implementation of the authentication algorithm. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to disclose stored credentials, leading to further compromise. Fixed in TL-WR940N(US)_V6_3.20.1 Build 220801 ['2022-08-25 - Vulnerability reported to vendor', '2022-11-21 - Coordinated public release of advisory'] ExLuck https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-22-1615/
title: TP-Link TL-WR940N httpd Incorrect Implementation of Authentication Algorithm Information Disclosure Vulnerability
